port.label: Overlay port
port.description: The overlay talks to the mod on this port, on this computer only (127.0.0.1).

startOverlay.label: Start the overlay with the server

overlayWithInGameUi.label: Overlay as well as the in-game panels
overlayWithInGameUi.description: While the in-game QoL panels (NativeMods) are running, the overlay window hides itself, and it comes back when they stop. On: the overlay stays shown alongside them.

keep.label: Items that stay in the inventory

shownTabLast.label: The tab shown takes what no other tab does

chartLocker.label: Charts go into the Chart Locker
chartLocker.description: The Allflame league's charts go into their tab of the Chart Locker (the Sovereign's deck) before any stash tab; a full locker tab leaves them for the stash.

sulphurToLocker.label: Dead Man's Sulphur goes into the Chart Locker
sulphurToLocker.description: Off: Sulphur goes to the Currency tab like other currency. Voyages take Sulphur from the locker, the inventory or the stash either way.

enabled.label: On when you log in
enabled.description: The overlay's Prices button or /qol prices switches them; the switch stays as you set it for each character.

minimumChaos.label: Smallest worth shown as a game popup (chaos)
minimumChaos.description: The game's own number popup shows whole numbers only, so 1 is the least it can show.

popupIcon.label: The popup's picture
popupIcon.description: orbs: the game's Chaos Orb or Divine Orb picture, shrunk. gold: the gold coin the game shows when you pick up gold.

standard.label: Standard's prices instead of the current league's

overlay.label: Price lines in the overlay
overlay.description: Every priced pickup, to the cent (+0.08 chaos  Jeweller's Orb), beside your character. Needs the overlay running.

overlayWithPopups.label: Overlay price lines even when the game shows its popup
overlayWithPopups.description: Off: a pickup that gets the game's own number popup gets no overlay line, so the price never shows twice. Pickups worth too little for the popup (under 1 chaos) still get an overlay line.

remember.label: Remember the Prices switch between sessions
remember.description: Off: each login starts as "On when you log in" says (the switch still holds across areas).

style.label: How the overlay shows prices
style.description: float: each pickup's text, with no box, floats up and fades away. box: the old way, the recent lines in a dark box, no fade.

place.label: Where the overlay's prices show
place.description: feet: at your character's feet, each a little apart, like loot games do. topleft: under the rows of buffs. right: to the right of your character.

scatter.label: At your feet: how far apart they start (pixels at 1080p)

feetX.label: At your feet: move the spot left (-) or right (+)

feetY.label: At your feet: move the spot up (-) or down (+)

floatSeconds.label: Floating text: seconds until it is gone

floatHold.label: Floating text: seconds it stays solid before fading

floatRise.label: Floating text: how far it rises (pixels at 1080p)

place.label: Where the stash buttons go
place.description: below: in a row under the stash grid, above Highlight Items. beside: in a column right of the stash (where they were before).

x.label: Left edge (pixels at 1080p)
x.description: -1: centred under the stash. Scales with the window height like the game's panels.

y.label: Top edge (pixels at 1080p)
y.description: Only for below: the default puts the row in the dark band between the stash grid and Highlight Items.

stackSize.label: Stack size
stackSize.description: Every stackable item except divination cards and shards; written to content/stacks.json, applied on the next start. 1: the game's own sizes.

uniqueCopies.label: The unique tab keeps copies
uniqueCopies.description: A second copy goes to a quad tab "Unique Copies" and fills the unique tab's cell when you take the first out.

vendorConfirm.label: Vendor tab asks for a second press

requirements.label: Item restrictions
requirements.description: Switches for the game's item restrictions. Items already shown keep their old level requirement until they are sent again (change area).

noLevel.label: No level requirements
noLevel.description: You can equip items, abyss jewels, charms and tinctures above your level, and they work (their mods, socketed jewels and gems count). Gems keep their own level requirements.

noStrength.label: No strength requirements
noStrength.description: Gear, and gems with the switch below, need no strength.

noDexterity.label: No dexterity requirements
noDexterity.description: Gear, and gems with the switch below, need no dexterity.

noIntelligence.label: No intelligence requirements
noIntelligence.description: Gear, and gems with the switch below, need no intelligence.

gems.label: Gems too
gems.description: The attribute switches also count for gems. Private build only: elsewhere the server still turns a gem's skill off when the attribute is short.

anyHands.label: Any weapon pair
anyHands.description: Private build: a bow with a shield, a quiver without a bow, a two-handed weapon with something in the off hand. The client may still refuse some on its side.

twoHandedOffHand.label: Two-handed weapons in the off hand
twoHandedOffHand.description: Private build: wield two two-handed weapons (only the main hand's is drawn on the character). The client may still refuse.

harvestPanel.label: Harvest panel
harvestPanel.description: While the Horticrafting Station holds an item, the overlay shows the classic Harvest crafts (harvestcrafts mod) to pick from, with a Craft button.

toasts.label: Pop-ups from other mods on the overlay
toasts.description: Such as Cosmetic Drops showing what you unlocked.
